97	def plot_reliability_diagram(confidences, accuracies, n_bins=10,
98	                              label='', color='#0072B2',
99	                              title='Reliability Diagram',
100	                              outpath='reliability.pdf'):
101	    """
102	    confidences, accuracies: 各样本的 confidence 和 binary correct (0/1)
103	    """
104	    bin_edges = np.linspace(0, 1, n_bins + 1)
105	    bin_accs, bin_confs, bin_counts = [], [], []
106	
107	    for i in range(n_bins):
108	        lo, hi = bin_edges[i], bin_edges[i+1]
109	        mask = (confidences >= lo) & (confidences < hi)
110	        if mask.sum() > 0:
111	            bin_accs.append(accuracies[mask].mean())
112	            bin_confs.append(confidences[mask].mean())
113	            bin_counts.append(mask.sum())
114	        else:
115	            bin_accs.append(float('nan'))
116	            bin_confs.append((lo + hi) / 2)
117	            bin_counts.append(0)
118	
119	    bin_accs = np.array(bin_accs)
120	    bin_confs = np.array(bin_confs)
121	
122	    fig, (ax_main, ax_hist) = plt.subplots(
123	        2, 1, figsize=(4, 4.5), gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [3, 1]},
124	        sharex=True
125	    )
126	
127	    # 主图：gaps
128	    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
129	                color=color, alpha=0.7, label='Accuracy', zorder=2)
130	    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_confs - bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
131	                bottom=bin_accs, color='red', alpha=0.3, label='Gap', zorder=2)
132	    ax_main.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', linewidth=1, zorder=3, label='Perfect')
133	    ax_main.set_xlim(0, 1); ax_main.set_ylim(0, 1)
134	    ax_main.set_ylabel('Accuracy')
135	    ax_main.set_title(title)

138	
139	    # ECE annotation

141	                    np.abs(bin_accs - bin_confs))

143	                 ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=9,
144	                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8))
145

148	                color=color, alpha=0.5)

150	    ax_hist.set_xlabel('Confidence')
151	
152	    plt.tight_layout()

377	    if n == 0: return 0, 0

```python
def plot_reliability_diagram(confidences, accuracies, n_bins=10,
                              label='', color='#0072B2',
                              title='Reliability Diagram',
                              outpath='reliability.pdf'):
    """
    confidences, accuracies: 各样本的 confidence 和 binary correct (0/1)
    """
    bin_edges = np.linspace(0, 1, n_bins + 1)
    bin_accs, bin_confs, bin_counts = [], [], []

    for i in range(n_bins):
        lo, hi = bin_edges[i], bin_edges[i+1]
        mask = (confidences >= lo) & (confidences < hi)
        if mask.sum() > 0:
            bin_accs.append(accuracies[mask].mean())
            bin_confs.append(confidences[mask].mean())
            bin_counts.append(mask.sum())
        else:
            bin_accs.append(float('nan'))
            bin_confs.append((lo + hi) / 2)
            bin_counts.append(0)

    bin_accs = np.array(bin_accs)
    bin_confs = np.array(bin_confs)

    fig, (ax_main, ax_hist) = plt.subplots(
        2, 1, figsize=(4, 4.5), gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [3, 1]},
        sharex=True
    )

    # 主图：gaps
    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                color=color, alpha=0.7, label='Accuracy', zorder=2)
    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_confs - bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                bottom=bin_accs, color='red', alpha=0.3, label='Gap', zorder=2)
    ax_main.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', linewidth=1, zorder=3, label='Perfect')
    ax_main.set_xlim(0, 1); ax_main.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax_main.set_ylabel('Accuracy')
    ax_main.set_title(title)
    ax_main.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
    ax_main.grid(True, alpha=0.3, zorder=1)

    # ECE annotation
    ece = np.nansum(np.array(bin_counts) / sum(bin_counts) *
                    np.abs(bin_accs - bin_confs))
    ax_main.text(0.98, 0.02, f'ECE={ece:.3f}', transform=ax_main.transAxes,
                 ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=9,
                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8))

    # 直方图（样本密度）
    ax_hist.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_counts, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                color=color, alpha=0.5)
    ax_hist.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=9)
    ax_hist.set_xlabel('Confidence')

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
```

def wilson_ci(p, n, z=1.96):
    if n == 0: return 0, 0
    denom = 1 + z**2 / n

    half = z * np.sqrt((p*(1-p) + z**2/(4*n)) / n) / denom
    return max(0, center - half), min(1, center + half)

"""Generate fig_bound: SC gain vs degeneracy bound (2-panel)."""
import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

OUT_DIR = Path(__file__).parent

with open(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "artifacts" / "p_impossibility" / "bound_verification.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

configs = data["per_config"]

# --- Parameters from paper ---
ALPHA = 0.068
G_ND_REF = 14.8
EPSILON = 0.3
THETA_CRIT = 0.70

# --- Dataset styling (colorblind-friendly Tol bright + distinct markers) ---
STYLE = {
    "FewNERD": {"color": "#4477AA", "marker": "o", "label": "FewNERD"},
    "SciERC":  {"color": "#EE6677", "marker": "^", "label": "SciERC"},
    "CoNLL":   {"color": "#228833", "marker": "s", "label": "CoNLL"},
}

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.9,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.9,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.9,
    'xtick.major.size': 3.5,
    'ytick.major.size': 3.5,
    'mathtext.fontset': 'dejavusans',
})

MARKER_SIZE = 55
EDGE_W = 0.6

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(7.2, 2.9), gridspec_kw={"wspace": 0.30})

# ===== Left panel: SC gain vs Degeneracy =====
for c in configs:
    s = STYLE[c["dataset"]]
    ax1.scatter(c["D"], c["actual_best_delta_pp"],
                color=s["color"], marker=s["marker"],
                s=MARKER_SIZE, zorder=5, edgecolors="black",
                linewidths=EDGE_W, alpha=0.92)

# Bound curve
D_range = np.linspace(0, 0.85, 200)
bound_curve = (1 - D_range) * G_ND_REF * ALPHA
bound_line, = ax1.plot(D_range, bound_curve, color="#CC3333", linewidth=2.2,
                       zorder=4, label=fr"Bound ($\alpha$={ALPHA})")

vline = ax1.axvline(x=THETA_CRIT, color="0.30", linestyle="--", linewidth=1.2,
                    zorder=3, label=fr"$\theta_{{\mathrm{{crit}}}}{{=}}{THETA_CRIT}$")
hline = ax1.axhline(y=EPSILON, color="0.30", linestyle=":", linewidth=1.3,
                    zorder=3, label=fr"$\varepsilon{{=}}{EPSILON}$ pp")
ax1.axhline(y=0, color="0.5", linewidth=0.6, zorder=2)

# Dataset proxy handles
ds_handles = []
for ds in ["FewNERD", "SciERC", "CoNLL"]:
    s = STYLE[ds]
    h = ax1.scatter([], [], color=s["color"], marker=s["marker"], s=MARKER_SIZE,
                    edgecolors="black", linewidths=EDGE_W, label=s["label"])
    ds_handles.append(h)

ax1.set_xlabel(r"Degeneracy rate $D$")
ax1.set_ylabel(r"SC gain $\Delta F_1$ (pp)")
ax1.set_xlim(-0.02, 0.85)
ax1.set_ylim(-1.0, 2.1)

# Two-column legend at top-left to avoid bound curve in upper-right
leg1 = ax1.legend(
    handles=ds_handles + [bound_line, vline, hline],
    loc="upper left",
    framealpha=0.93, edgecolor="0.75",
    handletextpad=0.35, borderpad=0.35, labelspacing=0.25,
    columnspacing=0.9, fontsize=8.2, ncol=2,
)

# ===== Right panel: Ratio to weak bound (positive-gain only) =====
positive = [c for c in configs if c["actual_best_delta_pp"] > 0]
for c in positive:
    s = STYLE[c["dataset"]]
    ax2.scatter(c["D"], c["bound_ratio"],
                color=s["color"], marker=s["marker"],
                s=MARKER_SIZE, zorder=5, edgecolors="black",
                linewidths=EDGE_W, alpha=0.92)

ceil_line = ax2.axhline(y=0.13, color="#CC3333", linestyle="--", linewidth=1.8,
                         zorder=4, label=r"Empirical ceiling $\approx 0.13$")
ax2.axhline(y=0, color="0.5", linewidth=0.6, zorder=2)

# Dataset proxy handles
ds_handles2 = []
for ds in ["FewNERD", "SciERC", "CoNLL"]:
    s = STYLE[ds]
    h = ax2.scatter([], [], color=s["color"], marker=s["marker"], s=MARKER_SIZE,
                    edgecolors="black", linewidths=EDGE_W, label=s["label"])
    ds_handles2.append(h)

ax2.set_xlabel(r"Degeneracy rate $D$")
ax2.set_ylabel("Ratio to weak bound")
ax2.set_xlim(-0.02, 0.85)
ax2.set_ylim(-0.005, 0.19)
ax2.legend(
    handles=ds_handles2 + [ceil_line],
    loc="upper right",
    framealpha=0.93, edgecolor="0.75",
    handletextpad=0.35, borderpad=0.35, labelspacing=0.25,
    fontsize=8.2,
)

for ax in (ax1, ax2):
    ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
    ax.tick_params(direction="out")

fig.savefig(OUT_DIR / "fig_bound.pdf")
fig.savefig(OUT_DIR / "fig_bound.png")
print("Saved fig_bound.pdf and fig_bound.png")

Data: Oracle F1 (best-of-N upper bound) per (dataset, model) at
N in {1,2,4,8,16,32}. Power-law fit F1(N) = a - b * N^(-c) (R^2 > 0.999
across all model-dataset fits). Greedy (T=0) baselines shown as horizontal
dashed lines plus X markers at N=1.

Data points were transcribed from the canonical fig_oracle_scaling.pdf;
power-law parameters are recomputed here via scipy.optimize.curve_fit.
"""
import os
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 9,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.6,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.9,
    'mathtext.fontset': 'dejavusans',
})

# Unified paper palette
STYLE = {
    'CoNLL':   {'color': '#228833', 'marker': 's'},
    'SciERC':  {'color': '#EE6677', 'marker': '^'},
    'FewNERD': {'color': '#4477AA', 'marker': 'o'},
}
DATASETS = ['SciERC', 'CoNLL', 'FewNERD']
MODELS = ['Qwen2.5-7B', 'LLaMA-3.1-8B']
LSTYLE = {'Qwen2.5-7B': '-', 'LLaMA-3.1-8B': '--'}

# Oracle F1 datapoints transcribed from canonical chart.
DATA = {
    ('SciERC',  'Qwen2.5-7B'):   {'N': [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32], 'F1': [0.642, 0.700, 0.750, 0.788, 0.819, 0.842]},
    ('SciERC',  'LLaMA-3.1-8B'): {'N': [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32], 'F1': [0.632, 0.698, 0.743, 0.779, 0.810, 0.838]},
    ('CoNLL',   'Qwen2.5-7B'):   {'N': [1, 2, 4, 8, 16],     'F1': [0.873, 0.918, 0.942, 0.954, 0.963]},
    ('CoNLL',   'LLaMA-3.1-8B'): {'N': [1, 2, 4, 8, 16],     'F1': [0.927, 0.936, 0.942, 0.948, 0.952]},
    ('FewNERD', 'Qwen2.5-7B'):   {'N': [1, 2, 4, 8, 16],     'F1': [0.748, 0.815, 0.858, 0.886, 0.912]},
    # FewNERD LLaMA fit excludes N=1 (4-pt fit) -- displayed point at N=1 if available.
    ('FewNERD', 'LLaMA-3.1-8B'): {'N': [1, 2, 4, 8, 16],     'F1': [0.705, 0.793, 0.848, 0.886, 0.912],
                                  'fit_skip_first': True},
}

# Greedy (T=0) F1 -- one value per dataset (held constant across models in the original).
GREEDY = {'SciERC': 0.663, 'CoNLL': 0.913, 'FewNERD': 0.794}


def power_fit(N, F1):
    """Fit F1(N) = a - b * N^(-c). Returns (a, b, c, R2)."""
    N = np.asarray(N, dtype=float)
    F1 = np.asarray(F1, dtype=float)

    def m(N, a, b, c):
        return a - b * np.power(N, -c)

    a0 = float(F1.max()) + 0.02
    b0 = max(float(F1.max() - F1.min()), 0.02)
    c0 = 0.5
    popt, _ = curve_fit(m, N, F1, p0=[a0, b0, c0],
                        bounds=([0.5, 0.0, 0.05], [1.2, 3.0, 3.0]),
                        maxfev=20000)
    a, b, c = popt
    pred = m(N, a, b, c)
    ss_res = float(np.sum((F1 - pred) ** 2))
    ss_tot = float(np.sum((F1 - F1.mean()) ** 2))
    r2 = 1.0 - ss_res / ss_tot if ss_tot > 0 else 1.0
    return a, b, c, r2


def main():
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.5, 3.5))

    N_curve = np.geomspace(1, 32, 400)
    fit_results = {}

    # Horizontal greedy baselines first (per dataset, drawn once).
    for ds in DATASETS:
        ax.axhline(y=GREEDY[ds], color=STYLE[ds]['color'], linestyle=':',
                   linewidth=0.9, alpha=0.45, zorder=1)
        # X marker at N=1 for greedy
        ax.scatter([1], [GREEDY[ds]], marker='x', color=STYLE[ds]['color'],
                   s=38, linewidths=1.5, alpha=0.75, zorder=2)

    for ds in DATASETS:
        sty = STYLE[ds]
        color = sty['color']
        for model in MODELS:
            key = (ds, model)
            if key not in DATA:
                continue
            d = DATA[key]
            N = np.array(d['N'], dtype=float)
            F1 = np.array(d['F1'], dtype=float)

            if d.get('fit_skip_first'):
                a, b, c, r2 = power_fit(N[1:], F1[1:])
            else:
                a, b, c, r2 = power_fit(N, F1)
            fit_results[key] = (a, b, c, r2)

            ls = LSTYLE[model]
            ax.plot(N_curve, a - b * np.power(N_curve, -c),
                    linestyle=ls, color=color, alpha=0.55, linewidth=1.2, zorder=2)
            ax.scatter(N, F1, marker=sty['marker'], facecolor=color,
                       edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, s=44, zorder=4)

    ax.set_xscale('log', base=2)
    ax.set_xticks([1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32])
    ax.set_xticklabels(['1', '2', '4', '8', '16', '32'])
    ax.set_xlim(0.85, 38)
    ax.set_ylim(0.60, 1.00)
    ax.set_xlabel(r'Number of Samples ($N$)')
    ax.set_ylabel(r'Oracle $F_1$')

    # Equation label
    ax.text(0.02, 0.97, r'$F_1(N) = a - b\,N^{-c}$',
            transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=10, va='top', ha='left',
            color='#555555')

    # Right-edge per-curve fit annotations (kept compact).
    label_x = 34.0
    seen = set()
    for ds in DATASETS:
        for model in MODELS:
            key = (ds, model)
            if key not in fit_results:
                continue
            a, b, c, _ = fit_results[key]
            color = STYLE[ds]['color']
            xs = DATA[key]['N']
            ymax = a - b * (max(xs) ** (-c))
            if ds == 'CoNLL':
                tag = f'$a{{=}}{a:.2f},b{{=}}{b:.2f}$'
            else:
                tag = f'$c{{=}}{c:.2f}$'
            # offset second model's label slightly downward to avoid overlap
            offset = -0.012 if model == 'LLaMA-3.1-8B' else 0.012
            ax.text(label_x, ymax + offset, tag, fontsize=7, color=color,
                    va='center', ha='left', alpha=0.9)
            seen.add(key)

    # Two-part legend: datasets (colors+markers), models (linestyles).
    ds_handles = [
        Line2D([0], [0], color=STYLE[ds]['color'],
               marker=STYLE[ds]['marker'], linestyle='-',
               linewidth=1.2, markersize=6, label=ds)
        for ds in DATASETS
    ]
    md_handles = [
        Line2D([0], [0], color='#666666', linestyle=LSTYLE[m],
               linewidth=1.4, label=m)
        for m in MODELS
    ]
    md_handles.append(
        Line2D([0], [0], color='#666666', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.9,
               alpha=0.6, label=r'Greedy ($T{=}0$)')
    )
    leg1 = ax.legend(handles=ds_handles, loc='lower right',
                     bbox_to_anchor=(0.99, 0.02), frameon=False,
                     fontsize=9, handlelength=1.6, labelspacing=0.25)
    ax.add_artist(leg1)
    ax.legend(handles=md_handles, loc='lower right',
              bbox_to_anchor=(0.99, 0.28), frameon=False,
              fontsize=8, handlelength=2.0, labelspacing=0.25)

    out_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(out_dir, 'fig_oracle_scaling.pdf'), format='pdf')
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(out_dir, 'fig_oracle_scaling.png'), format='png')
    plt.close(fig)
    print('Saved fig_oracle_scaling.pdf and .png')
    print('Power-law fits (a - b * N^-c):')
    for k, (a, b, c, r2) in fit_results.items():
        print(f'  {k}: a={a:.3f} b={b:.3f} c={c:.3f} R2={r2:.4f}')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
